title: Grateful Dead Live at Iowa State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: Master Reel -> Dat -> CD -> EAC -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard upgrade with crystal‑clear audio, showcasing Jerry’s debut Wolf guitar tone and Phil’s booming bass on a stellar 1973 performance.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the pristine, hiss‑free sound that Charlie Miller’s mastering brings to this partial soundboard capture. The show itself is praised as one of ’73’s finest, highlighted by Jerry Garcia’s new Wolf guitar tone and Phil Lesh “dropping bombs” on bass, making it worthy of a commercial release.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews emphasize both exceptional recording quality and outstanding performance, leaving little doubt the show merits near‑perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No hiss, crystal‑clear mix; reviewers call it a major upgrade and a Charlie Miller audio masterpiece despite being a partial release.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as one of the best of 1973, flowing so well that it deserves commercial release; no specific set‑list issues noted.

band_member_comments.Jerry: New ‘Wolf’ guitar sounds awesome and is a major highlight of the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Dropping bombs left and right – bass work praised as spectacular.
